implemented: Account-synced chat font size, link underline, display-name style, interface density, message layout/gap, UI zoom, UI-only saturation, reduced motion/OS sync, GIF playback, and animated emoji preferences.
Real channel and DM message selectors, member/server rows, profile names, navigation controls, and preview tokens consume the settings.
UI saturation no longer filters user-uploaded photos, video, attachments, or screen shares.
Turkish and English profile language selection is persisted through the profile API and applied after login.
TTS rate and preview use browser speech synthesis; incoming channel and DM plaintext is spoken only when enabled, while URLs are not read aloud.
The 3/5/10/15/20-second accessibility duration extends ordinary in-app toasts without shortening longer or persistent notices.
Animated stickers support always, interaction-only, and never modes; interaction mode works with pointer hover and keyboard focus.
High-contrast mode, live OS contrast synchronization, and non-color switch indicators are account-synced and applied at the shared DOM/CSS layer.
Automatic, 12-hour, and 24-hour account time formats are applied by shared chat/admin date utilities and migrated remaining direct date-time surfaces.
Attachment descriptions remain available to assistive technology and can be displayed visibly; legacy composer mode keeps the native textarea while suppressing rich picker popups and buttons.
Role-color mode changes actual message author rendering between colored names, separate color dots, and hidden role color.
Official-message styles are restricted to server-identified bot/application authors and never inferred from arbitrary message text.
The live preview includes messages, reactions, links, a sample button, role-color modes, official-message styles, and presence indicators using the same shared preference tokens.
